name: Compliance Posture Assessment
description: Continuously assesses the agent's compliance posture against active regulatory overlays. Generates posture scores, identifies compliance gaps, and tracks remediation progress for each applicable framework.
threat_addressed: Security posture degrades over time through configuration drift, policy exceptions, new agent deployments that skip assessment, and changing regulatory requirements. Without continuous tracking, gaps accumulate silently.
enforcement_mechanism: Continuous compliance posture calculation per agent and ecosystem-wide. AKSI pass/fail rates tracked over time. Deviations prioritized by severity and regulatory overlay impact. Trend analysis identifies persistent gaps.

security_outcome.pass: Posture dashboard current. Deviation records include AKSI ID, agent, timestamp, failure reason, and impact. Trends analyzed per defined interval.
security_outcome.fail: Compliance gaps identified in one or more active overlay requirements.

display_detail: Assesses compliance posture against active regulatory overlays and identifies gaps.
remediation_hint_template: Compliance gaps detected. Review the posture report and address identified gaps for each active overlay.
